title: Aquarium
content: I have a recurring dream that I am walking through an aquarium after hours. The tanks are floor to ceiling and completely empty, just full of water that looks like the middle of the ocean. I am walking down the middle of the hallway with tanks on either side of me, the floor is black carpet, and there are short stairs with wooden railings. The lights are off but the tanks are letting out a blue glow. It’s kind of creepy when I wake up and think about it, but when I’m asleep I’m completely calm.
